side.description: Side view: the hips sink below the shoulder-to-ankle line, then the same rep with the glutes and abs braced so the body holds one straight plank.

front.description: Front view: the lower back dips and the shoulders creep forward, then a corrected rep where the whole torso stays level.

side.description: Side view: the hips ride high into a tent shape, then the same rep with the hips lowered until shoulders, hips and ankles form one line.

front.description: Front view: the hips ride up and the shoulders rock back over the hands, then a corrected rep where the back flattens and the hips drop level with the shoulders.

side.description: Side view: a half rep that stops well short, then a full rep lowering until the chest is a fist off the floor and the elbows pass ninety degrees.

front.description: Front view: the chest barely moves on the first rep, then a full-depth rep where the chest clearly drops between the hands.

side.description: Side view: the rep stops short at the top with the elbows still bent, then a rep pressed all the way to straight arms before the next descent.

front.description: Front view: the arms never straighten between reps, then a rep finished with a full lockout and the torso still braced.

side.description: Side view: the head drops toward the floor and the neck folds shut, then the same rep with a neutral neck carried in line with the spine and the gaze just ahead of the hands.

front.description: Front view: the head tilts and the shoulders ride up toward the ears, then a corrected rep with the neck long and the shoulders pulled down.

side.description: Side view: the upper arms fan away from the ribs, then a rep where the elbows stay close and travel backwards rather than sideways.

front.description: Front view: the elbows swing out past ninety degrees from the torso, then the same rep with the elbows tucked to about forty-five so they track back past the ribs.

side.description: Side view exemplar: one clean rep at full depth and full lockout with a straight body line, about two seconds down and one second up.

front.description: Front view exemplar: one clean rep with the elbows tucked, the hands under the shoulders, and the torso level the whole way through.
